page.overview:
What is War of the Ring?

Southern theatre: Gondor Northern theatre:Rhovanion

Vast number of Orcs/Uruks; Unknown numbers of Dunlendings, Easterlings, Haradrim (more than 18,000), Variags, and Trolls, and one large fleet of Corsairs of Umbar

and many Elves, Dwarves, Eagles, Ents, and Hobbits

The War of the Ring, or Great War of the Ring, was a massive conflict near the end of the Third Age fought by the Dark Lord Sauron against the Free Peoples for reacquisition of the One Ring (which he made) and dominion over the entire continent. Together with the Quest of Mount Doom, it comprises the broad plotline of . The war pitted Sauron and his armies of Orcs, trolls, evil men, and other dark creatures against the allied forces of Men of the West, Elves, and Dwarves, aided by the Istari, Ents of Fangorn Forest, Dead Men of Dunharrow, and Great Eagles of the Misty Mountains.
